_doc: Domain randomization ranges for humanoid_pallet_sim.py (PLAN.md 2.5). On by default (--dr) for data generation and
evaluation; --no-dr gives the nominal scene (dome light 1200, plain table, nominal head camera, nominal part physics).
Each episode draws its values from its own stream (seed, 2025), so a seed has the same layout with and without DR.
Uniform ranges [lo, hi] unless noted. Part colours are NOT randomized: they name the parts in the task string.

table._doc: plain colour (HSV) or one of scripts/data/textures/table_*.png (make_table_textures.py) tinted by that colour

head_camera._doc: mounting error of the head camera, per axis: position +/- d_pos_m, rotation (roll, pitch, yaw in the camera frame) +/- d_rot_deg; same box as the FOV analysis of 2026-10-05 (FOV 55 deg keeps the work area in view)

parts._doc: per part: friction coefficient (static = dynamic) and mass scale (inertia scaled with it)
